form.div:
Auto-Registered Device — Pending Activation This device contacted the server on its own via ADMS push and was created INACTIVE for safety. It may have connected using a bare IP address or your raw domain (no /db/ path), which bypasses any intended database filter.
Its attendance punches are currently rejected (the device holds and resends them).
It still shows a heartbeat (Online) so you can identify it.
Confirm the Serial Number and IP below are a device you recognise, then click Review & Activate. Buffered punches are then accepted automatically.
If you do NOT recognise this device, leave it inactive or delete it — no data is accepted while it stays inactive.
This device is archived and will not receive scheduled downloads or ADMS attendance pushes. Click Restore to reactivate it.

div.div:
ADMS / Hybrid — Device Firmware Setup
On your ZKTeco device go to Menu → Comm → Cloud Server Setting
Set Server Address to the value from Server Address (firmware) above.
Example: myodoo.com/db/my_database
⚠ No https:// — firmware takes host + path only.
Set Server Port to the value from Server Port (firmware) above:
8069 — direct Odoo, no proxy
80 — HTTP via nginx/Apache
443 — HTTPS via nginx/Apache
If your device has an HTTPS / SSL toggle: turn ON if port is 443, OFF otherwise.
Save and restart the device.
Single database: address looks like myodoo.com/db/my_database — copy exactly.
Multiple databases: each database has its own address. Always copy from this page — do not type manually.
Devices that cannot enter a /db/ path (IP or raw domain):
Many ZKTeco firmwares accept only a bare IP or domain — no URL path. In that case use the Raw Domain or Server IP field above instead of the /db/ address.
Without the /db/ path the request lands on whatever database your dbfilter selects. On Odoo.sh each domain already maps to exactly one database, so the raw domain works directly.
Odoo.sh + IP does NOT work: on Odoo.sh the IP is a shared proxy that routes by domain name, not by IP — a device pointed at a raw IP cannot be routed to your database. Always use the domain (Server Port 443, HTTPS ON). The Server IP field only works on your own server / VPS, where a changing IP is fine — just update it here when it changes.
On Odoo.sh — use the Raw Domain: copy the Raw Domain field above into the device (Server Port 443, HTTPS ON). Each Odoo.sh domain maps to exactly one database, so no /db/ path is needed — this is the recommended, simplest setup for Odoo.sh customers.
On-premises with several databases: a raw IP or raw domain (no /db/ path) may hand-shake into a different database than you expect — whichever your dbfilter resolves. The device is still auto-created INACTIVE, but it may appear in another database. If you do not see the pending device here, check your other databases too — or add the /db/ path so it always lands in the right one.
Safety: any device that reaches the server this way and is not already registered is auto-created INACTIVE. It shows Online (heartbeat) but its punches are held and rejected until you open it and click Review & Activate. This prevents a stranger's device — or one pointed at the wrong database — from silently injecting attendance.
Use Check Server Ports above to confirm which port (443 / 80 / 8069) is actually reachable before configuring the firmware.

div.p: Hybrid uses ADMS for attendance push (device → Odoo) and PyZK for hardware control (Odoo → device: door, LCD, voice, enroll).

ul.li: Configure Server Address exactly as above
Works identically to Cloud (ADMS) mode
Requires Odoo to reach device on TCP port 4370
On-premise Odoo: works automatically on same LAN
Cloud Odoo: requires VPN or port forwarding on the site router
Without network access: use Cloud (ADMS) mode instead

div.p: When an employee forgets to punch out, this module closes the stuck record automatically based on each employee's Work Schedule (Employee form → Work Information). Configure globally at Attendances → Configuration → Settings → Shift & Auto-Close.

ul.li: Fixed schedule (e.g. 09:00–17:00): check-out set at shift end.
Night shift (e.g. 21:00–05:00): handled across midnight.
Flexible / no schedule: fallback window (default 16h), check-out set at check-in + default shift hours (default 8h).
Offset (hours) adds grace past the shift end — 0 = strict, 1/2/5/… = credit brief overtime. Free integer input.
Runs hourly via cron "Biometric: Auto-Close Stale Open Attendance".
Manual cleanup: Attendances → Management → Open Attendance (No Check-Out) → select rows → Actions → Auto-Close at Shift End.

div.div: Odoo native Automatic Check-Out (Attendances → Configuration → Settings) is respected — when it is ON, fixed-schedule employees are left to Odoo's cron and we only handle flexible / no-schedule employees. No clash, no double-close.

Safety net: if a record that native should have closed is still open past the Native Safety Net threshold (default 36h) — because the native cron failed, someone edited the record manually, or the schedule was switched from flexible to fixed mid-shift — our module steps in and closes it using the current work schedule.

Real-time Mode: Attendance events are captured INSTANTLY as they happen!

ul.li: No more 5-minute polling delay
Instant notifications via Odoo bus
Automatic LCD messages and audio feedback
Real-time dashboard updates

div.p: Click "Start Live Capture" in the header to begin monitoring.

ul.li: For LOCAL network (192.168.x.x): 60 seconds ✓ (Default - Fast & Efficient)
For PUBLIC IP (Internet): 90-120 seconds ✓ (Recommended - Accounts for latency)
For Poor Connection: 120-180 seconds (Higher tolerance for delays)

div.p: Tip: Higher timeout = More patience before checking status. This is especially important when connecting via internet/public IP!
Live Capture enables real-time attendance monitoring. When enabled:

ul.li: Attendance events are captured as they happen (instead of polling every X minutes)
Instant notifications sent to relevant users
LCD messages and audio feedback triggered automatically
Better user experience and faster data sync

div.p: To enable: Check "Enable Live Capture" checkbox and click "Start Live Capture" button.

ul.li: LCD Messages: Max 20 characters per line. Use {name} placeholder for employee name (if supported by device).
Audio Alerts: Voice index 0-55. Different sounds available. 0=default beep, 1=error beep.
Testing: Use test buttons to preview LCD messages and audio sounds before enabling.
